name: use-debounce-callback
title: useDebounceCallback
description: Configuration options for controlling the behavior of the debounced function.

tags.template: - Type of the original callback function.

types.name: DebouncedState
types.description:
Represents the state and control functions of a debounced callback.
Subsequent calls to the debounced function return the result of the last invocation.
Note: If there are no previous invocations, the result will be undefined.
Ensure proper handling in your code.

types.name: ControlFunctions
types.description: Functions to manage a debounced callback.

properties.name: isPending
properties.description: Checks if there are any pending function invocations.

parameters.name: func
parameters.description: - The callback function to be debounced.

parameters.name: delay
parameters.description: - The delay in milliseconds before the callback is invoked (default is `500` milliseconds).

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: - Options to control the behavior of the debounced function.

properties.name: leading
properties.description: Determines whether the function should be invoked on the leading edge of the timeout.

properties.name: trailing
properties.description: Determines whether the function should be invoked on the trailing edge of the timeout.

properties.name: maxWait
properties.description: The maximum time the specified function is allowed to be delayed before it is invoked.

returnType.name: DebouncedState<T>
returnType.description: A debounced version of the original callback along with control functions.
